toast.defaultChangedBody: {{name}} will be preselected on new invoices.
toast.carrierRemovedBody: Carriers that have invoices are deactivated, not deleted.

page.title: Tariffs
page.sub: Expected amounts are calculated from these tariffs. Prices exclude VAT.

noCarriers.title: No carriers yet
noCarriers.body: Add FedEx, UPS, DHL or a domestic carrier, then enter the contract tariff or import it from Excel.
noCarriers.bodyView: Carriers and tariffs appear here once they are added.

noTariffs.title: No tariffs for {{name}}
noTariffs.body: Without a tariff, invoice lines are marked "No tariff". Upload the carrier's price list (Excel, CSV or PDF) or enter the prices manually.
noTariffs.bodyView: Without a tariff, invoice lines are marked "No tariff". Tariffs appear here once they are added.

delTariff.label: Tariff
delTariff.title: Delete {{name}}?
delTariff.body: This tariff will not be used for new invoices.
delTariff.pastInvoices: Past invoices are not affected; they keep the prices from the day they were calculated.

delCarrier.label: Carrier
delCarrier.title: Remove {{name}}?
delCarrier.body: A carrier with invoices is deactivated, not deleted. A carrier without invoices is deleted along with its tariffs.

carrierModal.templateHelp: Invoice columns are mapped automatically using this template.
carrierModal.name: Display name

select.loadFailed: Tariffs could not be loaded; the default tariff will be used.
select.dateSelected: The tariff valid on {{date}} is selected; change it to use a different tariff.
select.defaultSelected: The default tariff is selected; change it to use a different tariff.
select.allLines: All lines of the invoice are compared against this tariff.
select.label: Tariff
select.outOfRange: This tariff is not valid on {{date}} ({{validity}}); calculations will still use it.

packLimits.title: Pak and envelope limits
packLimits.help: Pak and envelope shipments within these limits are checked at the pak/envelope rate. Empty fields use the carrier's known limit.
packLimits.envEdgesHelp: Enter all three edges or leave them all empty.

error.number: Limits must be numbers greater than zero.
error.pakKgRequired: This carrier's pak limit is unknown: enter the max weight first.
error.envKgRequired: This carrier's envelope limit is unknown: enter the max weight first.
